messages:
jordan: getting a spike of 403s from a few Dedicated tenants, started ~04:12 UTC. Support tickets and a PD alert are coming in. https://redwood.internal/alerts/INC-331765
ops-bot: Alert: auth-service.jwks-validation-errors rate=95m, p95=2.1s, 403s reported (since 04:12)
jordan: sample log: `{"ts":"2026-03-17T04:13:02Z","req":"/v1/generate","tenant":"acme-prod","status":403,"error":"invalid_token","detail":"kid not found"}`
clara: oncall investigating. Did we run the legacy-key backfill last night? I remember a staggered push for older KIDs to central JWKS store.
lucas: yes, backfill job bkf-2026-03-17-0350 ran starting 03:50 UTC. It tried to insert legacy public keys into jwks_store but race with signing-worker produced tokens containing KIDs that haven't propagated to some regions.
mike: repro locally: `curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer <jwt-with-kid-abc123>\" https://api.redwood.example/v1/ping` -> `HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden` body `{"error":"kid-not-found","kid":"abc123"}`
sarah: we had a canary keyflip in us-west2 earlier; backfill targeted global store. Looks like propagation TTL + CDN cache invalidation didn't line up.
jordan: impact: 3 tenants showing sustained 403s, several webhooks failing which triggers billing write errors. CS triage is active. Priority: restore auth for affected tenants.
clara: immediate mitigation:
- pause backfill job bkf-2026-03-17-0350 (DONE)
- stop issuing new tokens with new KIDs (rollback signing-worker)
- reduce jwks cache TTL at edge proxies and flush CDN for affected regions
- run narrow backfill for only impacted tenants once mapping is validated
lucas: commands I ran to rollback signing-worker canary: `kubectl -n auth scale deploy signing-worker --replicas=0` then `kubectl -n auth set image deploy/signing-worker redwood/signing:2026.03.01` — that restored acceptance on my test proxy.
mike: warning: do NOT re-run full global backfill until we reconcile kid_map <> jwks_store. There's a mismatch: kid_map.kid -> public_key_id doesn't match propagation_id in jwks_store.
sarah: support template for outreach (CS):
```
We are investigating an authentication issue that may cause 403 responses for token validation. Engineers have paused key propagation and are reverting recent signing changes. No customer secret rotation is required at this time. ETA 30-60 minutes.
```
jordan: CS asked for list of affected tenants + any safe customer-side workaround (can tenants rotate tokens themselves?)
clara: customer-side rotate won't help if tokens already issued reference unknown KIDs. Short-term we can offer scoped server-side token rotation for high-severity tenants via a managed flow, but primary fix is server rollback + reconciliation.
lucas: eng repro notes: extract kid from token header `echo <jwt> | cut -d'.' -f1 | base64 -d | jq -r '.kid'` then check JWKS `curl https://auth.redwood.internal/.well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys[] | select(.kid==\"abc123\")'` — should exist if propagation worked.
deploy-bot: bkf-2026-03-17-0350 paused by lucas at 04:21 UTC. signing-worker reverted to image redwood/signing:2026.03.01 at 04:25 UTC.
mike: metrics: 403s dropped back to baseline in us-west2 after rollback. still seeing residual 403s in eu-central — likely propagation lag + CDN TTL.
clara: next actions (owners):
- lucas: run reconciliation script to validate kid_map vs jwks_store and produce a fix plan for affected tenants (ETA 30m)
- eng-infra (sarah): temporarily lower jwks cache TTL at edge and flush keys for eu-central, monitor error rate (ETA 15m)
- support (jordan): open dedicated ticket per tenant and send initial outage notice to customers (now)
- post-incident: implement staged backfill with pre/post checks, prevent signing-worker from issuing new KIDs until propagation verified, and add automated reconciliation with ordering guarantees
jordan: escalated to SRE lead and assigned account execs for high-touch customers. CS is sending outreach now.
eva-support: confirmed impacted tenants: Acme Prod, BetaRetail, FinCo — all notified and given the workaround note.
clara: thanks everyone. keep updates in this thread, we'll run a short postmortem once stable. :white_check_mark:
